changelog: v0.16.11: Aligned mobile streaming provider architecture with PC version. Replaced standalone Flixera with PC server naming (4Animo: A-1, HD-1, S-1; Miruro: 14 sub-servers with PC alias mapping; AnimeSuge: Vidstream-2, HD-1). Injected Accept-Encoding: identity to eliminate Cloudflare Brotli decoding crashes in ExoPlayer. Added active NovusCloud ReCloud CDN resolution and multi-domain failover.
